title: Mount Imperius
author: kaleidofish
description:
Your name is Rosa Sanchez. You are part of a five-man expedition up Mount Imperius, a six thousander with conditions that rival Everest. Although you're not the most experienced climber on this trek, you do have two of the Seven Summits under your belt. You're more humble about that feat than a certain loud mouth...
